title: centaurea napulifera subsp. orbelica
intro: Centaurea napulifera subsp. orbelica, commonly known as Orbelia, is a plant species in the aster family known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Orbelia include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate digestive issues, and act as an antiseptic, making it effective in treating wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Orbelia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, among others. These constituents have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making Orbelia a valuable plant for traditional medicine and potential pharmaceutical applications.
